name: Sarcophagus
details: A weathered granite sarcophagus is partially buried below rubble.

name: Rusted Chest
details: A rusted iron chest sits in the corner.

name: Mummified Warrior
details: The mummified corpse stirs to life from amidst loose rubble. It is always hostile.

name: Lost Traveler
details: A terrified refugee cowers in the corner.

name: Broken Stairs
details: The stairs are slick with moisture and partially crumbled.

name: Pit of Filth
details: A hidden pit filled with rotting waste blocks the center of the room.

name: Rotted Skeleton
details: A skeleton lies in the corner, its bones brittle and yellowed. It suddenly lunges, a rusty dagger in its hand.

name: Collapsing Ceiling
details: The ceiling is unstable and threatens to collapse at any moment. A loud rumble precedes the fall of a large stone.

name: Moldy Tome
details: An ancient, moldy tome lies open on a stone pedestal. The pages are brittle and the ink is faded.

name: Crazed Hermit
details: A ragged figure cowers in the corner, muttering to himself. He looks up with wild, fearful eyes.

name: Hidden Spike Pit
details: A hidden pit filled with sharpened spikes lies beneath a thin layer of dust. It is easily missed.

name: Giant Rat
details: A giant rat, its fur matted with filth, scurries out from the shadows. It hisses and bares its teeth.

name: Slippery Floor
details: The floor is slick with a greasy substance. A misplaced step could send you sliding into a wall of spikes.

name: Broken Statue
details: A broken statue of a forgotten god stands in the corner. Its face is worn smooth by time and dampness.

name: Zombie
details: A shambling zombie, its flesh rotting and its eyes cloudy, lunges at you with a groan.

name: Cursed Book
details: A book with a leather cover and a strange symbol lies on a table. Reading it causes a sudden headache.

name: Pile of Bones
details: A pile of bones, some human and some animal, lies in the corner. They are old and brittle.

name: Trapped Merchant
details: A merchant, bound and gagged, is tied to a post. He looks up at you with pleading eyes.

name: Falling Stone
details: A large stone hangs from the ceiling, held by a rusted chain. It swings precariously above the path.

name: Rusty Sword
details: A rusty sword lies on the floor, its blade corroded and its handle wrapped in rotting leather.

name: Ghoul
details: A ghoul, its skin pale and its eyes glowing, scuttles out from the shadows. It snarls and lunges.

name: Poisoned Arrow
details: A poisoned arrow is hidden in a loose stone. It is barely visible, but its tip glints in the light.

name: Moldy Tapestry
details: A moldy tapestry hangs on the wall, depicting a scene of a great battle. The colors are faded and the fabric is rotting.

name: Crawling Hand
details: A severed hand, still twitching, crawls out from the floor. It reaches for your ankle with a silent scream.

name: Collapsing Bridge
details: A narrow bridge spans a chasm. The wood is rotten and the ropes are frayed. It looks like it might collapse.

name: Broken Shield
details: A broken shield lies on the floor, its wood splintered and its metal dented. It looks like it has seen better days.

name: Lost Child
details: A small child, crying and alone, cowers in the corner. He looks up at you with wide, fearful eyes.

name: Sudden Pit
details: A hidden pit lies beneath a thin layer of leaves. It is easily missed, but deep and dark.

name: Rusty Key
details: A rusty key lies on a small table. It looks old and worn, but might still work.

name: Wight
details: A wight, its skin pale and its eyes glowing, stands in the shadows. It raises a skeletal hand and points.

name: Gas Leak
details: A hissing sound comes from a crack in the wall. The air is thick with a noxious green gas.

name: Broken Lantern
details: A broken lantern lies on the floor, its glass shattered and its oil spilled. It is dark and useless.

name: Goblin Scavenger
details: A small, green-skinned goblin scuttles out from behind a pile of rubble, wielding a jagged knife.

name: Tripwire
details: A nearly invisible wire stretches across the path. Stepping on it triggers a hidden mechanism.

name: Rotten Crate
details: A wooden crate, rotted by dampness, sits in the corner. It smells of rotting fruit.

name: Dying Soldier
details: A soldier in tattered armor lies on the floor, bleeding from a deep wound. He gasps for air.

name: Falling Rocks
details: Loose rocks hang precariously from the ceiling. A loud crash signals the start of a rockslide.

name: Ancient Relic
details: A strange, glowing relic sits on a pedestal. It pulses with a faint, blue light.

name: Shadow Stalker
details: A dark, shadowy figure emerges from the darkness, its eyes glowing with malice.

name: Hidden Dagger
details: A hidden dagger is strapped to the inside of a broken shield. It is easily missed.
